observations: All eight crops retain their authored identity and non-green fruits/flowers; young and mature foliage receives the same effect.
All five wall materials carry the same botanical mark, sparks and native-terrain roots. Perforated surfaces naturally fragment the glyph.
Open gates have no central aura; damage is visibly morphed and its pose is asserted.
Grass can occlude ground roots as in the native terrain; these are not an overlay through vegetation.
limits: Artist mockups have smoother crop meshes and more ornamental wall details than the retained original assets.
This is desktop medium-quality visual coverage; no mobile hardware claim.
